bundle.shortDescription: Local-first project catalog with optional local AI-app connections.
bundle.longDescription: Code Hangar inventories local AI coding projects and sessions, encrypts its catalog at rest, and adds explicitly enabled AI-app integration. Claude, Codex and Cursor connect through a separate local MCP stdio process, app configuration and named pipes. AI Assist starts Off and permits only an explicit, reviewed request to the user-selected loopback or HTTPS provider through the feature-gated hangar-ai client. There is no telemetry, updater, remote Git or implicit/background network; project and action scopes remain explicit, and mutation gates stay in Code Hangar.
